history: One context per event in the bounded shared design risk inventory, using the existing outcome window and observed wet/neutralisation definitions. Preserve exclusions; do not infer context from absent records.
likelihood: Categorical joint wet/neutralisation state, independent events conditional on a circuit probability vector.
posterior: Independent per-circuit Dirichlet(prior_alpha + event_counts). No pooling, decay, month effects or fitted hyperparameters.
unseen_circuit: Use the unchanged prior when the circuit has no eligible context history.
dependence: Share each circuit probability vector across its future visits within a posterior trajectory; draw a single event condition shared by all entrants. Separate circuit vectors are independent.
race_parameters: Condition frequencies have independent priors and factor from the existing outcome posterior conditional on observed historical contexts. Sample on the same chain/draw axes in a separate identity-keyed random namespace.
single_event_scoring: Analytically integrate condition-frequency uncertainty with its posterior mean, sum condition-specific joint target/panel masses within each paired race-parameter draw, then normalize over both conditions and draws. Do not average context-specific conditional scores using unadjusted weights.
season_simulation: Use shared sampled circuit probabilities, not independent posterior-mean condition draws for repeated visits.
forecast_source: Training history only; observed test-event conditions and later data are forbidden.
scope: An explicit historical approximation for development. No weather nowcast, source-vintage verification, seasonality, nonstationarity, incident causality, qualifying-weather response or accepted scoring registration is established.
tuning: Preserve this version and all results. Revisions require a separately declared version, never adjustment after seeing a favorable or unfavorable score.
